description: 1992 is the Year of the Water Monkey in the Chinese zodiac, from February 4, 1992 to January 22, 1993. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1992 is the Year of the Water Monkey, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 4, 1992 and ended on January 22, 1993, so people born in 1992 before Feb 4 belong to the Metal Goat year.

sections.heading: 1992 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Water Monkey year on February 4, 1992, and the year ran to January 22, 1993. So a birth date of Feb 4, 1992 or later counts as Water Monkey, and so do early 1993 birthdays through Jan 22; births in 1992 before Feb 4 still belong to the Metal Goat. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1932 are Water Monkey years too. That Tuesday new year arrived with the Sun in Aquarius in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Water Monkey is like
paragraphs: In a Water Monkey year, the Monkey's quick mind takes on fluid, intuitive depth. Classical readings describe those born then as graceful talkers, astute judges of character and lovers of ideas of every kind. Their intelligence works quietly. Because so much energy flows outward, firm boundaries are often recommended, along with the courage to address conflict directly rather than slipping around it.

In classical thought, Water belongs to the north and to the deep, resting energy of winter, the season when life gathers strength out of sight. As a year stem, it tends to make an animal more reflective, adaptable and emotionally attuned. People born under a Water stem are often described as clever negotiators, sensitive friends and natural mediators who prefer influence to force. They value understanding and tend to think before they act. The caution traditionally attached to Water is fluidity taken too far: avoiding conflict, keeping too much hidden and losing a clear sense of their own direction.

sections.heading: 1992 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the digits of this year reduce to 3, associated with expression, creativity and sociability, so a 3 year is described as lively and communicative. The digits of 1992 add up to 21, which reduces to 3. The Monkey holds the ninth place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Metal. Set beside the year's Water stem, metal generates Water, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Metal Goat and the year after is the Water Rooster.

Chinese almanacs name 1992 Ren-Shen, pairing the Water stem Ren with the branch Shen. Both are Yang, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1992?
faq.answer: 1992 is the Year of the Water Monkey. It started on February 4, 1992 and ended on January 22, 1993.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1992?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 4. Born before February 4, 1992, you are a Metal Goat; born on or after it, you are a Water Monkey.

faq.question: What element is 1992 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Water, a Yang year. The Monkey's own fixed element is Metal; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1992?
faq.answer: Ren-Shen. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Water Monkey year?
faq.answer: 2052, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1932.
